title: Key-value input field
description: Pairs of words, a key and its value, one line each — metadata, headers, parameters —, in the order they were written. The field's value is a list of pairs (`pairs`), not a text: `value` stays unset. Sent as a list, each pair under its index — `form[field][0][key]`, `form[field][0][value]`. Keys are unique within the field; values are text.
